name: Resonance, Gen 1 stack
formula: P(outperform 3x) = sigma(b0 + b_c*logit(q_c) + b_x*logit(q_x) + b_h*logit(q_h) + m_c*[q_c missing] + m_x*[q_x missing] + m_h*[q_h missing]), q clamped to [0.01, 0.99], a missing q enters as 0

components.q_c: PAX2 Classifier v3, full arm, calibrated probability (predictions-v3.jsonl)
components.q_x: craft rank: share of the channel's measured baseline shorts outscored under composition-ranker-combined.json (ties half)
components.q_h: headline percentile: pax2-headline score against headline-v1-reference.json

validation.rule: leave one held-out channel out over the encoder's 10 held-out channels (the only rows v3 and the pair picker never trained on); pooled AUC of out-of-channel predictions

acceptance.rule: stack held-out AUC >= the best single component's, else that component alone serves as Resonance

weights.fitOn: all held-out-channel baseline rows, L2 0.001 on the slopes

notes: The held-out rows' outperform share is high because baseline media were mostly label-picked; AUC is unaffected by the base rate, the intercept is not, so the served probability needs recalibration against the uniform catalog rate before display.

futureInputs.note: audited census columns whose trait passed the registry rule; they join the stack at the next refit (Gen 2)
